Legal • Openink Hub

What you should know before you rely on our tools.

This Disclaimer sets expectations around the services, software, and information Openink Hub provides. By using our website or platform, you agree to the terms below.

Effective date

Contact

Section 1

Information provided in good faith

No warranties

Everything on openinkhub.io — content, tools, software, and services — is offered for general informational and business optimization purposes. We work hard to keep it accurate and current, but we make no warranties, express or implied, about its completeness, reliability, or suitability for any particular purpose. Any reliance you place on it is at your own risk.

Section 2

No guaranteed rankings or results

SEO, AI search optimization, and Google Business Profile performance all depend on algorithms that third parties — Google, Bing, Meta — own and change constantly.

Results vary

Rankings aren't promised

We don't guarantee specific rankings, traffic increases, or revenue growth. Case studies and testimonials on our site reflect past outcomes and don't guarantee the same result for you.

Algorithms shift

We can't control third-party updates

Search engines update their algorithms often. We're not liable for ranking fluctuations, indexing issues, or traffic drops tied to core algorithm updates or penalty actions outside our control.

Section 3

Third-party platforms & software behaviour

01

Third-party platforms & APIs

Our automation tools lean heavily on integrations with Meta's WhatsApp Business API, Google's Business Profile API, and various AI language models. We're not responsible for interruptions, rate limits, suspensions, or policy changes those platforms make. Keeping your own account in good standing with each provider's terms is your responsibility.

02

Software & automation, provided "as is"

Our SaaS platforms, AI content engines, and chat agents come with no warranties of any kind. AI-generated content or chatbot responses can occasionally contain factual errors or "hallucinations" — you're responsible for reviewing and verifying automated output before it goes live or reaches customers. We also don't promise our systems will run uninterrupted, error-free, or entirely secure.

Section 4

Liability & professional advice

Limitation of liability

What we're not liable for

To the maximum extent the law allows, Openink Hub and our team aren't liable for lost profits, revenue, data, or goodwill; business interruptions from downtime or deployment; or unauthorized access to our servers or the data stored on them.

Not professional advice

Seek your own counsel

Nothing we provide amounts to legal, financial, or compliance advice. We recommend getting professional counsel to confirm your messaging, marketing, and data practices align with regional laws — including GDPR or TCPA where relevant.
